title: TU column selector hides Est. Lost Labor, persists across reload, and the export mirrors it
preconds:
Owner/admin logged in with TU access (reports project storage state)
A technician with a 3h WO clock and a 1h internal clock exists in the current calendar month (seeded via API), so the report is non-empty and Est. Lost Labor is non-zero
No saved TU view in this browser context, so the default five visible metric columns apply
